description:
Decision by Joe 2026-07-16 (follow-up batch gate): DROP the tuned seed-corpus
bundles until regenerated on live platforms.

Background: the 2026-07 tuning remediation (#1176 w0 discovery) proved the
tuning config never reached platform adapters on the direct CLI path, so the
325 corpus bundles claiming execution.tuning_mode="tuned" were almost
certainly physically untuned. Cross-submission comparisons against them are
unsound. The 203 bundles with no tuning_mode stay (they ingest honestly as
not-recorded).

preserves.behavior: Explorer ingest must not fail on the reduced corpus
The 203 mode-absent bundles and all notuning-era bundles stay untouched

verifications.expected: All passing; dataset shows zero tuned rows from the seed corpus

work_units.notes: Reuse the sweep logic (execution.tuning_mode == 'tuned') to build the removal list; commit the deletion with the list in the commit body.
work_units.summary: Enumerate and remove the 325 tuned bundles + their .manifest.json companions
Re-run explorer ingest over the remaining corpus; verify counts (expect 0 tuned, ~203 not-recorded)

work_units.notes: Note that tuned corpus cells should be regenerated post-#1176/#1180 on live platforms; list the affected platform/benchmark cells so regeneration has a checklist.
work_units.summary: Record the decision + regeneration path in results-data docs/README
